method: One same-size warmup; three measured warm handler samples; idle GPU; cool to <=55C before each; abort at >=83C; 500ms temperature/memory samples; schema: boolean plus 3-way multi-token enum. Contexts cycle the frozen cohort with unique ticket suffixes. No labelled accuracy evaluation. Complete cells from bounded runs; both modes used the same binary and exact request bodies; runs were not randomised.
